patch_description: Replace the current flat 176-param ansatz (score 0.86) with the higher-performing modular block design (score 0.89) that uses per-qubit RY, ring CRZ, per-qubit RX, skip-2, skip-3, and diameter CRZ entanglement layers, but extend it to three repeated blocks (all sharing the same 128 parameters) instead of two. This increases circuit depth/expressivity further while holding parameter count fixed at 128, testing whether additional shared-depth repetition pushes validation/test accuracy and combined score above the previous 0.89 plateau, following the given recommendation.
